about.headline: Umm Al Quwain's hyperlocal super-app
about.intro: UAQ Deals brings the entire local economy — grocery, pharmacy, restaurants, retail, services, real estate, automotive and more — into a single, easy-to-use platform that connects residents directly with the businesses around them.
about.feat1Desc: Built only for Umm Al Quwain — not a generic national app. That means faster deliveries, fairer prices, and genuinely local vendors.
about.feat2Desc: Shop, dine, hire, sell and browse from a single login — across six core categories and more than thirty vendor types.
about.feat3Desc: Our built-in coinback system turns everyday spending into real savings, keeping value within the community.
about.feat4Desc: Fast, reliable delivery from businesses in your own community, with transparent pricing and no hidden costs.
about.visionBody: To become the most trusted digital marketplace in Umm Al Quwain — the first place every resident opens when they need anything, and the platform every local business relies on to grow.
about.missionBody: To empower local businesses with digital tools, visibility, and customers — while giving residents a faster, fairer, and more rewarding way to shop and access services within their own community.

umrahPlatform.metaDescription: Proposal: a digital platform for Umrah package promotion, customer acquisition and booking management — built for Umm Al Quwain travel teams.

hero.title: Umrah Booking Growth & Management Platform
hero.subtitle: Umrah Package Promotion, Customer Acquisition & Booking Management System for Umm Al Quwain's travel teams — from package discovery to confirmed booking.

execSummary.title: A growth platform, not just an ad listing
execSummary.p1: UAQ Deals aims to develop a digital platform that helps Umrah travel teams promote their packages, attract potential pilgrims, manage customer enquiries, improve sales follow-ups and convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.
execSummary.p2: The proposed application combines a public-facing Umrah package marketplace with a business management dashboard for participating travel teams — providing an end-to-end booking growth workflow, from package discovery and customer enquiry to sales follow-up, booking confirmation and performance reporting.
execSummary.p3: The main objective is to create a scalable digital service that benefits customers, Umrah operators and UAQ Deals.

objectivesSection.title: What the platform is built to achieve
items: Increase the number of qualified Umrah package enquiries.
Help participating travel teams attract new customers.
Convert more enquiries into confirmed bookings through structured follow-ups.
Make Umrah packages easier to discover and compare.
Centralise customer enquiries and booking records.
Improve sales team productivity and accountability.
Establish sustainable revenue streams for UAQ Deals.
Build long-term relationships with customers and travel partners.

list.title: 3.1 — Umrah Package Marketplace
list.desc: Participating travel teams publish packages that customers can browse, compare and enquire about directly.
items: Available seats, based on verified operator information

list.title: 3.2 — Customer Enquiry Generation
list.desc: Multiple enquiry channels, each linked to a package and, where possible, its original marketing source — so teams can see which campaigns generate genuine interest.

list.title: 3.3 — Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
list.desc: A central CRM organises every enquiry and customer interaction, with controlled access and duplicate-lead detection.
list.note: Recommended lead statuses: New → Contacted → Interested → Follow-up Required → Booking Pending → Confirmed / Lost.

list.title: 3.4 — Sales Team Management
list.desc: Each participating travel team gets a dedicated workspace with role-based permissions.

list.title: 3.5 — Booking Management
list.desc: The booking module organises the customer journey after an enquiry, distinguishing an enquiry, a booking request and a confirmed booking.
items: 3. Travel team confirms package details and availability
4. Customer receives booking terms and payment instructions
5. Operator records the booking and payment status
list.note: A booking must not be marked confirmed until the authorised operator verifies the necessary details.

list.title: 3.6 — WhatsApp Communication & Follow-up
list.desc: WhatsApp as a key customer communication channel, using authorised integrations where required.

list.title: 3.7 — Digital Marketing Support
list.desc: Marketing tools for participating teams, with reports showing which sources produce enquiries and confirmed bookings.

list.title: 3.8 — Customer Assistance & Package Comparison
list.desc: Useful information surfaced before a customer ever contacts a sales representative. All published details are verified by the responsible operator and kept up to date.

umrahPlatform.breakQuote: “Attract. Capture. Qualify. Follow up. Convert. Retain.”
umrahPlatform.breakImgAlt: Pilgrims performing Umrah at the Kaaba

stages.title: Attract
stages.desc: Publish relevant packages and promote them through approved digital marketing channels.

stages.title: Capture
stages.desc: Make it easy for customers to enquire through a short form or WhatsApp.

stages.title: Qualify
stages.desc: Identify the customer's preferred dates, budget, group size and travel requirements.

stages.title: Follow Up
stages.desc: Assign a sales representative and schedule appropriate follow-up reminders.

stages.title: Convert
stages.desc: Help the operator confirm availability, provide accurate information and explain payment terms.

stages.title: Retain
stages.desc: Request feedback after the trip and encourage referrals through approved referral programmes.

revenue.title: How UAQ Deals monetises the platform

rows.desc: Monthly or annual fee for team dashboard access
Charges for promotional design and campaign management
Agreed fee for eligible, genuine customer enquiries
Contractually agreed commission on eligible confirmed bookings

revenue.note: Recommended approach: begin with a clear partner subscription or marketing service offering, then introduce additional revenue models once demand and operating costs are understood. Any commission or travel-related commercial arrangement must follow applicable UAE licensing and regulatory requirements.

kpis.title: How success will be measured
kpis.note: Baseline performance should be measured during the initial pilot. Targets should be established using actual results rather than unsupported estimates.

technical.title: Core components the build must include
items: Responsive website suitable for mobile devices
Secure database and authenticated user accounts
Separate administrator, manager and staff permissions
technical.note: If the platform later supports online payments, the payment gateway should be integrated securely — the application must not store raw payment card details. Passport and other sensitive traveller information should be collected only when necessary, protected through encryption and restricted access, and retained according to applicable requirements.

roadmap.title: From planning to growth, in four phases

phases.title: Planning
items: Agree on lead ownership and commercial terms
Confirm applicable licensing and compliance requirements

phases.title: Pilot Launch
items: Launch with a limited number of authorised travel partners
Collect feedback from operators and customers

phases.title: Growth & Automation
items: Mobile application development, if justified by demand

risk.title: What must be addressed before launch

items.title: Package accuracy
items.desc: Each operator must verify prices, departure dates, hotel details, inclusions and seat availability.

items.title: Customer privacy
items.desc: Collect only necessary information, restrict access and apply appropriate data-protection controls.

items.title: Booking disputes
items.desc: Clearly display payment terms, cancellation conditions, refund policies and the responsible operator's identity.

items.title: Lead ownership
items.desc: Establish transparent rules for duplicate enquiries, reassignment and partner access.

items.title: Marketing integrity
items.desc: Avoid misleading claims, fabricated reviews, false scarcity and unverified promotional offers.

items.title: Regulatory compliance
items.desc: Confirm applicable UAE travel, tourism, advertising, data-protection and commercial requirements before launch.

items.title: Payment security
items.desc: Use authorised payment providers and maintain reliable transaction records.

priorities.title: The first release, in order
priorities.note: These features provide a measurable starting point without requiring the expense and complexity of building every advanced feature at once.

value.title: What this unlocks, if executed well
items: Measure the progress from enquiry to confirmed booking
Create recurring revenue opportunities for UAQ Deals
value.note: Actual booking growth will depend on package competitiveness, marketing reach, customer trust, lead quality, operator reliability and sales execution. Results should be assessed through pilot data.

conclusion.label: Final Recommendation
conclusion.title: Build UAQ Deals as a customer-facing Umrah marketplace, supported by a dedicated partner management system — with booking conversion and customer experience as the primary performance objectives.
conclusion.sub: Begin with a focused MVP, validate demand through a controlled partner pilot, and expand based on measured business results.
conclusion.docNote: This proposal describes a recommended business and technology model. Financial projections, market size, partner commitments, licensing status and implementation costs must be validated separately before investment or commercial launch.

step1.title: Discover & compare packages
step1.desc: Customers browse verified Umrah packages — price, hotel, dates and inclusions laid out clearly, so they can compare before they ever pick up the phone.

step2.title: Enquire in seconds
step2.desc: A short form or a single WhatsApp tap — either way, the enquiry is captured against this exact package, with its marketing source attached automatically.

step3.title: The lead lands straight in the CRM
step3.desc: No spreadsheets, no missed enquiries. The lead appears instantly in the team's pipeline, ready to be assigned to a sales representative.

step4.title: Structured follow-up, on WhatsApp
step4.desc: The assigned rep sees exactly who to contact and when. Replies happen on WhatsApp, availability gets confirmed, and the lead status updates itself as the conversation moves forward.
